scope: Survey-grounded AI4AI catalog organized as Benchmarks, Harness Design, and Model Design.
overlap_policy: A paper may appear in multiple public collections but only once within each collection.
citation_policy: For papers indexed as multiple versions, retain the largest title-verified count reported by the configured sources.
year_grouping: All yearly rankings use first public appearance year; a later venue year never moves a paper into a newer cohort.

research_refresh.note: Screened 1,770 unique recent cs.AI/cs.CL titles with expanded agent, harness, tool-use, memory, post-training and self-distillation keywords, overlapping the November 8 pass. Independently swept recent cs.RO and checked primary search results for historical omissions. Verified 378 candidate primary arXiv pages and explicit v1 histories: 314 additions and 64 exclusions. Retrieved 11 full-paper renderings (the Jais 3 rendering was unavailable) and checked important official project/code pages, including all previous paper news picks. Reassessed every prior news item across the trailing 30 days and checked current official lab announcements. The literature search is bounded, not a completeness claim; old v1 dates on newly announced records are preserved rather than restamped.

metrics_refresh.note: Fresh title-verified OpenAlex work-ID batches from the previous verified receipt, followed by DOI and title fallback for uncovered records. Semantic Scholar live probe returned HTTP 429. No failed or unmatched query is converted into a zero; counts retain max(existing, observed). Authenticated GitHub REST checks every currently configured repository. Primary full papers and author projects were checked separately for new artifact links. Three paper-linked repositories (SPRING-5, parallel-agent-teams-scaling and ESI) repeatedly returned authenticated HTTP404; those new papers retain null code rather than fabricated stars. Singularity-Bench has executable code in its official repository despite a stale Code soon project header.
